verification: Mixed maturity: use each module's status and guide header. reviewed_on records the original source baseline, not a review of draft additions. No tenant operations were performed.

cloud_scope.AzureCloud: Detailed guides, subject to service, offer, region, permissions and current policy.
cloud_scope.AzureChinaCloud: Context identification only. Stop before reusing global service or benefit procedures.

modules.title: Cloud context, tools and provider registration
when_to_use: Confirm which cloud, tenant and subscription to use
Identify missing tools or provider registration
modules.audience: Founders and authorized platform operators
required_inputs: Intended cloud and target scope
Reference-only or explicitly authorized inspection
modules.expected_output: A confirmed context/tool checklist, with mismatches and unknowns called out.

modules.title: Preview, approve and recover resource changes
when_to_use: Preview changes to existing resources
Recover a partial operation without deleting unrelated resources
modules.audience: Platform operators and change approvers
required_inputs: Exact resource scope and desired delta
Cost, ownership and recovery constraints
modules.expected_output: A scoped change/approval plan and an evidence-based recovery or verification handoff.

modules.title: Startup credits, binding and expiry
when_to_use: Find activation, binding, remaining credits or expiry
Check whether the actual offer covers a model purchase
modules.audience: Founders, finance owners and authorized benefit owners
required_inputs: Cloud, program/offer and joining date
Intended account and subscription; authorization for live values
modules.expected_output: A benefit/binding checklist with separately sourced balance, validity and unresolved eligibility.

modules.title: Contract and compliance evidence: where to look and who decides
when_to_use: Locate provider DPA, BAA or regional contract evidence
Route a customer or investor due-diligence request
service_scope: Service/model scope and report access conditions
modules.audience: Founders and customer legal, compliance or contract owners
required_inputs: Exact evidence request and agreement/channel
Relevant service/model and responsible contract owner
modules.expected_output: A private evidence index and owner questions, not a legal or compliance verdict.

modules.title: Cost visibility, allocation and spending controls
when_to_use: Reconcile charges, credits or a spending spike
Inspect allocation, budgets and cost-monitoring ownership
modules.audience: Finance/FinOps owners and authorized platform operators
required_inputs: Billing scope, agreement, currency and period
Cost basis and requested comparison or control
modules.expected_output: A scoped cost/credit reconciliation, allocation gaps and an owned alert/control proposal.

modules.title: Marketplace acquisition and invoice access
when_to_use: Investigate a blocked Marketplace purchase or offer
Find the right invoice or billing-document access route
service_scope: Agreement-specific Azure invoices and billing roles
modules.audience: Procurement, finance and authorized billing owners
required_inputs: Cloud, agreement and billing/subscription scope
Seller/offer/plan or invoice period
modules.expected_output: A classified acquisition/document blocker and the correct authorized-owner handoff.

modules.title: Resource, data-plane and billing permissions
when_to_use: Separate model invocation, deployment and billing access
Identify the narrow missing permission without defaulting to Owner
modules.audience: Platform administrators and authorized resource or finance users
required_inputs: Intended principal and operation
Exact resource or billing scope and sanitized failure
modules.expected_output: An operation-to-scope permission matrix and a least-privilege administrator request.

modules.title: Federation, credential lifecycle and ownership
when_to_use: Check GitHub-to-Azure federation or credential lifecycle
Plan a departing person's access and ownership handoff
service_scope: GitHub Actions OIDC and Azure authorization
Azure identity, billing ownership and directory transfer boundaries
modules.audience: Identity/platform administrators and ownership approvers
required_inputs: Automation or ownership-handoff task
Principal/workflow, current scope and intended owner
modules.expected_output: A scoped identity/access inventory and an approved-owner transition checklist.

modules.title: Current tier, quota allocation and capacity
when_to_use: Inspect a model quota tier or allocation
Separate quota approval, deployment capacity and runtime throttling
modules.audience: Model platform operators and quota-request owners
required_inputs: Subscription, model/version/type and region/data zone
Requested units or incident interval and sanitized error
modules.expected_output: Separate tier, allowance, allocation and capacity findings with their evidence and unknowns.

modules.title: Available models and deployment options
when_to_use: Check whether a model/version can be used
Compare supported deployment and processing-location choices
service_scope: Microsoft Foundry model catalog and deployment choices
modules.audience: Founders, model platform owners and compliance reviewers
required_inputs: Cloud, resource generation and model/version
Intended processing boundary and authorized subscription scope
modules.expected_output: An evidence-backed candidate table separating availability, permission, terms, quota and capacity.

modules.title: Model usage, costs and rate limiting
when_to_use: Explain model usage/cost differences or an unexpected charge
Investigate 429s and effective runtime limits
modules.audience: Model operators and authorized FinOps investigators
required_inputs: Deployment, model/version/type and endpoint
UTC incident interval and aligned cost period
modules.expected_output: A usage/cost/limit comparison with supported explanations, gaps and escalation evidence.

modules.title: Foundry access, audit and cost-control overview
when_to_use: Choose a route for model access, audit/logging or cost monitoring
Triage an unexplained model-cost increase without assuming key theft
modules.audience: Founders and platform, security/data and FinOps owners
required_inputs: Question and intended outcome
Known service/endpoint and desired reference or inspection mode
modules.expected_output: A reading path, selected task owners and missing inputs; this overview does not authorize execution.

modules.title: Foundry model access security and credential containment
when_to_use: Inspect model identities, keys and network access
Plan authorized containment or rotation after credible credential exposure
service_scope: Endpoint-supported Entra, resource-key and network controls
modules.audience: Platform/identity administrators and incident owners
required_inputs: Exact endpoint/resource and approved consumers
Authentication type, network path and exposure/incident interval if relevant
modules.expected_output: An access-path inventory, scoped control gaps and an approval/verification plan without secret values.

modules.title: Foundry request auditing and safe LLM logs
when_to_use: Establish model request and trace audit coverage
Decide whether LLM content is collected and who may access or export it
service_scope: Foundry model diagnostics and application/gateway telemetry
Log Analytics access, query auditing and retention
modules.audience: Security/data owners and authorized platform/log administrators
required_inputs: Resource/endpoint, UTC interval and audit purpose
Existing telemetry destinations, approved readers and retention requirements
modules.expected_output: A coverage/privacy matrix, evidence gaps and a minimal approved logging and access-control plan.

modules.title: Effective guardrails and modification applications
when_to_use: Inspect which guardrail is actually associated with a deployment
Distinguish configurable controls from approval-required modifications
service_scope: Separate modified-guardrail and abuse-monitoring application routes
modules.audience: Platform operators and authorized safety/compliance owners
required_inputs: Cloud, resource generation and deployment/agent
Requested behavior and permitted read/change scope
modules.expected_output: An effective-control/assignment finding and a legitimate approval or support route.

modules.title: Warnings, version changes and retirement
when_to_use: Classify a model warning or retirement notice
Identify affected deployments, owners and deadlines
modules.audience: Model platform owners and notice recipients
required_inputs: Sanitized notice, origin, timestamp and deadline
Approved target deployment scope
modules.expected_output: An affected/unaffected deployment list and an owner/deadline handoff with unresolved facts.

modules.title: GPU quota, restrictions and allocation
when_to_use: Check GPU VM eligibility and quota
Investigate allocation failure despite approved quota
modules.audience: ML/platform operators and capacity-request owners
required_inputs: Cloud, subscription/offer, SKU/family and region/zone
Quantity, priority and date needed or sanitized allocation error
modules.expected_output: Separate SKU, quota and capacity findings and a correctly scoped request/escalation.

modules.title: Compute state, interruptions and billing
when_to_use: Explain VM stop/deallocation state and residual charges
Classify a platform interruption using existing evidence
modules.audience: Compute operators and authorized finance investigators
required_inputs: Exact instances, priority and attached-resource scope
Billing period and UTC incident interval
modules.expected_output: A state/charge breakdown and a supported interruption or approved-transition handoff.

modules.title: Container Apps: plans, limits and idle costs
when_to_use: Inspect hosting replicas, plan constraints or idle charges
Separate an app setting from environment quota and capacity
service_scope: Other hosts require their own service documentation
modules.audience: Container Apps operators and authorized cost owners
required_inputs: Selected app/environment, region and workload profile
Requested limit or aligned billing/metric interval
modules.expected_output: A plan/settings/observed-state comparison with attributable costs and supported next steps.

modules.title: Container Apps: deployment access and domains
when_to_use: Investigate a Container Apps deployment or image-pull failure
Inspect hostname, DNS and certificate bindings
service_scope: Selected registry, ingress and domain/certificate access paths
modules.audience: Container Apps operators and domain/registry owners
required_inputs: Selected app/environment and deployment time
Image reference or hostname and sanitized platform error
modules.expected_output: A classified platform-access/binding finding and an exact owner/change or application handoff.

modules.title: PostgreSQL Flexible Server: versions, limits and maintenance
when_to_use: Inspect database version, storage/connection warnings or maintenance
Check platform-supported configuration and upgrade options
service_scope: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server only
Other engines require their own lifecycle and limit references
modules.audience: Database/platform operators and change approvers
required_inputs: Exact engine/resource, region, SKU/version and topology
Warning/maintenance interval and intended platform outcome
modules.expected_output: A version/configuration/limit finding and a supported owner-approved platform plan.

modules.title: Blob Storage: access, request limits and costs
when_to_use: Inspect Blob access or storage throttling
Attribute storage and transfer charges to actual meters
modules.audience: Storage/platform operators and authorized cost investigators
required_inputs: Account type, region, redundancy/tier and access path
Sanitized error or aligned metric/cost interval
modules.expected_output: A scoped access/limit or meter-cost finding without inspecting object contents.

modules.title: PostgreSQL and Blob Storage: backups and retained data
when_to_use: Check whether a requested recovery point actually exists
Inspect retained resources and obligations before restore or deletion
service_scope: Blob Storage protection and retention features
modules.audience: Data/platform owners and restore/change approvers
required_inputs: Exact service/resource and required recovery point
Retention obligation and permitted inspection scope
modules.expected_output: An observed recovery/retention assessment and a scoped data-owner handoff.

modules.title: Private endpoints, DNS, access and policy denials
when_to_use: Separate DNS/network refusal from identity failures
Inspect private endpoint approval or organizational policy denial
service_scope: Private Link, DNS and Azure Policy evidence
modules.audience: Network/platform operators and governance owners
required_inputs: Approved source network and destination endpoint
Cloud, permitted path and sanitized error/operation reference
modules.expected_output: A supported failure classification and scoped owner action without bypassing isolation.

modules.title: Platform changes, audit coverage and retention
when_to_use: Find who changed a platform setting or role
Inspect existing audit capture, access and retention gaps
service_scope: Separate service/data-plane and Entra audit surfaces
modules.audience: Authorized platform, security and evidence owners
required_inputs: Exact resource/scope, operation and UTC interval
Authorized evidence recipient and permitted existing logs
modules.expected_output: A private evidence timeline with provenance, effective-state limits and capture gaps.

modules.title: Support eligibility, warning routing and evidence
when_to_use: Choose the correct benefit, billing, quota or technical-support route
Prepare sanitized evidence and verify a request's follow-through
service_scope: Program, billing, quota and safety-review handoffs
modules.audience: Authorized incident/request owners and affected platform teams
required_inputs: Sanitized issue, scope, UTC interval and impact
Relevant deadline and existing request/notice references
modules.expected_output: A classified support route, minimal evidence bundle and a next-owner/status handoff.
